code: # Base sum() gives 1 on x86-64 and 0 on Apple Silicon; xsum() gives 1. xsum(c(1e16, 1, -1e16)) #> [1] 1  # Neither platform's sum() gets this one right. sum(c(1e20, 1, -1e20)) #> [1] 0 xsum(c(1e20, 1, -1e20)) #> [1] 1  # The order of the terms never matters. x <- c(1, 1e100, 1, -1e100) xsum(x) == xsum(rev(x)) #> [1] TRUE  # Several arguments are summed together. xsum(1:10, c(0.5, 0.25), TRUE) #> [1] 56.75
